name: Featurebase activation 1
request: Write exactly one English activation email from the Featurebase team. Reader: A product manager who just created a Featurebase workspace and wants a place to collect requests. Ask them to do one thing: Set up the first feedback board. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.
target_market: A product manager who just created a Featurebase workspace and wants a place to collect requests.

intent.desired_action: Set up the first feedback board
